recognize_zh: 周邊血紅血球排列擁擠（血液濃縮），可見嗜中性球增多但無毒性顆粒、少量髓細胞、血小板稀少，並有細胞質深藍的免疫母細胞樣淋巴球（插圖）；在急性非心因性肺水腫病人，這組抹片特徵強烈提示漢他病毒心肺症候群。
features: Crowded, closely packed red cells even in the thin area, reflecting hemoconcentration
Increased neutrophils, including bands, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or vacuolation
Occasional immature granulocyte (myelocyte) consistent with left shift
Large immunoblastic lymphocytes with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, open chromatin and a clear perinuclear zone (inset)
Few platelets visible (thrombocytopenia); several smudged/disrupted leukocytes at the lower field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed red cells consistent with hemoconcentration and a neutrophilic leukocytosis with bands and occasional myelocytes but no toxic granulation. There are increased large immunoblastic lymphocytes with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei and relatively open chromatin, and platelets are sparse. No blasts or intracellular organisms are identified. In the context of acute noncardiogenic pulmonary edema, this constellation of neutrophilia without toxic change, left shift, immunoblasts, thrombocytopenia and hemoconcentration is highly suggestive of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, confirmed here by serology and PCR.

ddx.vs: Sepsis usually shows toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and vacuolated neutrophils, and lacks marked hemoconcentration with numerous immunoblasts.

ddx.dx: Infectious mononucleosis or other viral reactive lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: EBV/CMV produce abundant Downey-type reactive lymphocytes hugging red cells, without neutrophilia, left shift and hemoconcentration.
Leukemic blasts have fine chromatin and nucleoli with scant cytoplasm and form a monotonous population, unlike these plasmacytoid immunoblasts with mature neutrophils.
Dengue also causes thrombocytopenia, hemoconcentration and reactive lymphocytes but typically leukopenia rather than neutrophilic leukocytosis, and is separated by travel history and serology.
